notes.title: Heroes of the Citadel Demo Launch
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831671/a486a9958cfcb4faacb6d1731cdf21da12f7de5d.png
Join Us for the Heroes of the Citadel Live Broadcast at Steam Next Fest!

We're excited to announce that Heroes of the Citadel will be featured in a special live broadcast during Steam Next Fest! Join us on our first broadcast HoC demo build. We are hoping you would like our game and give us some feedback

Event Highlights:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831671/9ce2eff40e585af834d22361962ba5bb645ed135.png

Live Gameplay Demo: Witness the immersive world of Entaron come to life as we play through the demo, showcasing the unique mechanics and thrilling battles.

Hero Introductions: Meet the diverse heroes you'll recruit in the game. Learn about their unique abilities and how they can turn the tide of battle. Well there will be far more heroes on global launch this is just a small fraction.

Campaign Mode Playthrough: Experience a segment of the campaign mode, where strategy and quick thinking are key to overcoming formidable foes.


About Heroes of the Citadel
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831671/ffd6f8b0e6e16d7f6664e10e8a3f723601e2b439.png
Heroes of the Citadel is a free-to-play fantasy RPG auto battler set in a vibrant, immersive world. Players will encounter numerous obstacles requiring tactical thinking and the assembly of the most powerful team to defeat formidable foes. The game features a wide range of characters, equipment, and upgrades, offering players the chance to create unique teams of heroes that can save the world.
The demo version includes a campaign mode where players can recruit an interesting range of characters, representing just a fraction of the heroes that will be available in the final product. Additionally, users will experience several mechanics that developers are keen to test and refine based on player feedback. Funtico is actively seeking feedback to ensure the final release delivers the best possible gaming experience.

Game Lore
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831671/f58314f1e402f98e04f7204cd9fd8852523da95f.png
The fantasy world of Entaron is in peril. Players will confront powerful enemies, undertake challenging quests, and defend the Citadel. The story centers on Vorak, a powerful deity who seeks absolute dominion and destroys his divine brethren in his ruthless pursuit. Hope rises with the Citadel, forged by Arion, the last opposing god. Sacrificing his immortality, Arion aims to protect humanity and gather a team capable of defeating Vorak. Players will recruit heroes from a diverse range of characters, including knights, ninjas, demigods, and wizards.

Announcement and Availability
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831671/a9e830fdd243ba145c1675a992f516c4d6543eda.png
Heroes of the Citadel was first announced at the Taipei Game Show 2024, introducing Funtico's debut project. After almost six months of development, the first demo is now available on the Steam platform and soon at the Funtico website (funtico.com). The global launch of the full game is planned for the summer of 2024.

Be sure to join us for this exciting event and be among the first to experience the magic of Heroes of the Citadel. Mark your calendars and prepare for an epic journey!

notes.title: Dev Diary: Heroes of the Citadel
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831671/ffd6f8b0e6e16d7f6664e10e8a3f723601e2b439.png

Dev Diary: Heroes of the Citadel


Latest Updates from Heroes of the Citadel: Developing Raid Boss Events and Survival Mode!ːsteamhappyː

Welcome to our Dev Diary series! In each edition, we’ll put you directly in contact with the developers working on each Funtico game. 

We hope you enjoy the insider view of what our team is working on!

Dear Heroes,

We are excited to share progress on the development of two thrilling new features soon to come in "Heroes of the Citadel"! These updates are currently under active development, and we want to give you a sneak peek at what we are working on to enhance your gaming experience once you dive into our fantasy world.

Raid Boss Event: A New Challenge!

Our upcoming Raid Boss Event will offer you new exciting challenges. Once you reach a certain level, the Raid Boss icon will appear on your main screen, giving you the opportunity to challenge Bosses in a unique environment for special rewards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831671/e6b69fd880591c2171f8d4ac270acd602705e604.png

This timed event will reward those who are able to emerge victorious with exclusive items and skins to wear as a badge of honor!. But, beware! Each boss will have a special condition that changes with each event.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831671/e3aceb38850d739be2c26d4aa0ae50727a87d06b.png

Survival Mode: Endless Adventure!

In the developing Survival Mode, endless waves of enemies await you. Available after reaching the required level, this mode will challenge the limits of your endurance with a continuous flow of increasingly difficult opponents. 

Fight against time and foes to claim your place among the legends of the Citadel. Rewards will increase with each wave you overcome, providing not only coins but also a chance to obtain unique skins and other valuable items.

Development Process

We are in the process of setting up the timers and restart conditions for these events to ensure the most engaging and dynamic gameplay for you. All these innovations are being implemented with the goal of enriching your gameplay experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831671/a9e830fdd243ba145c1675a992f516c4d6543eda.png

Stay Updated

These new features are still in development, and we plan to launch them in the near future. Join our community on Discord to discuss these updates and share your thoughts on the new additions. 

Thank you for actively participating in our gaming community. We can’t wait to get you into  "Heroes of the Citadel" and start adventuring!

If you’re chomping at the bit as much as we are to dive into Heroes of the Citadel, wishlist us on Steam today so that you’re ready as soon as a playable version drops!

Looking forward to seeing you in the game,
The Heroes of the Citadel Team
